transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too. I guess I'm here because of what's been going on at work. I'm a transportation inspector, and... well, ever since I got this county safety award a while back, certain people in the department have been coming after me. 

They've been twisting my inspection reports around, and they keep asking me these really pointed budget questions. It's like they're trying to make me look crooked. I brought it up to my supervisor, but he just brushes it off and says it's a normal review process. But... I mean, I can tell what's actually happening. There is definitely a coordinated effort to discredit me going on, and it's just getting to be a lot to deal with.
Has anyone else actually confirmed for you that people at work are coordinating against you?

No, no one has come right out and said it to me. Like I mentioned, when I try to talk to my supervisor about it, he just brushes it off and says it's a normal review process. 

But... I mean, I don't really need anyone to confirm it because I can see it happening right in front of me. Ever since I got that county safety award, they've been twisting my inspection reports around and asking me all these pointed budget questions. It's obvious they're trying to make me look crooked. So even if my boss won't admit it, I can tell there's a coordinated effort to discredit me.
Have you been hearing voices when no one is there?

No, nothing like that. I don't hear voices or anything. It's... I mean, I'm just dealing with what's actually happening at the office, the things I can see them doing with my reports. But no, no voices.
If someone showed you clear proof that your coworkers were not coordinating against you, would you believe it?

I... I don't know what kind of proof you mean. I mean, I'm the one looking at my own inspection reports, and I can see how they're twisting them around. And the budget questions they keep asking me... they're very specific. It's not just a normal review, no matter what my supervisor says. Ever since I got that county safety award, it's been happening. So... if someone showed me something, I'd have to wonder where they got it, because I know what I'm seeing. There's definitely a coordinated effort to discredit me. I'm living it.
How long have you believed your coworkers are coordinating against you?

It's been going on for about a year now. Yeah, right around a year. Like I mentioned, it basically all started right after I got recognized for that county safety initiative. That's when things shifted and they started doing all this.
Aside from this situation at work, have you had trouble taking care of your usual responsibilities or daily life?

No, not really. I mean, outside of the office stuff, everything is pretty much normal. I still get to work on time every day, I do my inspections like I'm supposed to, and I keep up with my church activities on the weekends. I'm taking care of myself fine. The only time things get difficult or stressful is when someone brings up those altered reports or starts questioning me about the budget. But as far as my daily life goes, I'm handling everything just fine.
Before this started at work, have you generally tended to mistrust other people and assume they had harmful motives?

No, not at all. I mean, I've always gotten along fine with people. I trust my friends, my family, the people at church. I never had any reason to think people were out to get me before all this started. It's just... it's just this specific situation at work, because I can actually see what they're doing. But in general? No, I don't go around thinking people have bad intentions.
Have you had any experiences where your thoughts felt controlled, inserted, or taken out by someone else?

No, definitely not. I mean... my thoughts are my own. Nobody is controlling them or putting things in my head, if that's what you're asking. I just know what I see happening at the office with the reports and all that, but inside my own head? No, nothing like that at all.
Have other people told you that your speech or your thinking seems disorganized or hard to follow?

No, nobody's ever said anything like that to me. I communicate just fine. I mean, I talk to people all day for my job, doing my inspections and everything, and people understand me without any problems. My thoughts make perfect sense.
Have you noticed a loss of interest or motivation in things you usually enjoy?

No, not really. I mean, I still like doing the same things I've always liked. On the weekends, I still watch the games, hang out with my buddies... I haven't lost any interest in that kind of stuff. I still get up and go to work every day, even with everything going on there. I'm just as motivated as I always was.
Have you seen things that other people could not see?

No, I haven't. I mean... I don't see things that aren't there, if that's what you're getting at. Just regular stuff. The trains, the cargo, the people I work with. I'm not having visions or seeing anything out of the ordinary like that.
Do you believe for certain that your coworkers are deliberately trying to discredit you?

Yes, absolutely. That's actually why I'm here. Ever since I got that county safety award, certain people at work have been twisting my inspection reports. They keep asking these pointed budget questions, like they’re trying to make me look crooked. My supervisor tells me it’s just a normal review, but... I mean, I can tell what's going on. There is definitely a coordinated effort to discredit me.
Outside of your coworkers, do you think anyone else is trying to harm, monitor, or conspire against you?

No, not really. It's just the people at work. I don't have any problems with anyone outside of the job. Nobody is following me around or tapping my phone or anything like that. It's strictly tied to the yard and my inspection reports. My buddies, my family, everyone else is fine. It's just those guys at work.
Has this belief that your coworkers are trying to discredit you been present continuously for more than three months?

Yeah, definitely longer than three months. I'd say... it's been going on for about a year now. It started pretty much right after I got recognized for that county safety initiative, and it hasn't stopped since.
When you look at the inspection reports, can you point to a specific change in them that was made after you submitted them?

Well, no, not exactly. I mean, I can't just point to a specific number they erased or a sentence they rewrote, if that's what you mean. It's more about how they handle them after I turn them in. The way they question my findings, or... or how they bring up these budget issues that have nothing to do with safety. The reports themselves look the same when I print them out, but it's what they're doing with them behind closed doors to make me look bad.
Before this started at work, had you ever had any other fixed beliefs that other people said were not true?

No, never. I've never had anything like that happen before. I just go to work, do my job, and go home. I've never had any... you know, strange ideas or anything that people thought were made up. It's just this situation at work, that's it.
